decision: GO for one isolated CPU implementation of this exact plan; final frozen-source review required before any official GPU check
observed_trigger: Official f685c2533ebc4214 reports C7511 insufficient-register WGMMA serialization in both BIG specializations at96 registers despite zero stack/spill/local bytes. WAIT2 itself is rejected for promotion.
chosen_mechanism: 640 launched threads:512 consumers in four full warpgroups inc112; one128-thread producer warpgroup dec32 before splitting into unchanged32-thread weight and32-thread activation producers plus64 idle threads that join barrier2 once. Preserve the entire WAIT2 arithmetic and traffic.
critic_review: Read full plan, source role/producers/routing/finalizer context, final role-model source and author output. Independently validated CTA-pool arithmetic using the unchanged NVIDIA occupancy header in the separate critic budget proof.

Confirmed common initial PDL wait precedes the role split. Full producer donation precedes every producer-specific wait or return, so blocked consumer acquisitions cannot trap the donor behind a consumer-dependent barrier.

Confirmed selected participant counts: barrier2 becomes640 including both idle warps; barrier7 remains544; compute barrier1 stays512; per-compute-WG barriers remain128; existing ring-credit counts stay unchanged.

Confirmed consumer inc112 dominates an explicit else containing the whole original consumer body through finalizer. No new outlined helper or producer/consumer reconvergence into shared math is proposed.

Confirmed initial96 pool61440 exactly equals512*112+128*32. SM-total65536 arithmetic and register-padding assumptions are excluded; actual initial96/local0/positive occupancy guards precede both launch paths.

Confirmed byte-identical WAIT2 wgs_seg and inherited producers, math, routing, scratch and tile/ring geometry are requirements, alongside non-WGS preprocessing equality and actual-role execution over all640 thread IDs.

Requested and verified two corrections: distinguish inverse relative-speed ratio from direct harness/raw medians, and do not claim the occupancy-header proof establishes actual role placement in register partitions.

role_model.review_scope: Static independent review, not a duplicate full run. The model assumes eventual execution of the ready donor and treats a warpgroup action atomically; it does not simulate hardware register partitions or every CUDA interleaving.

compiler_requirements: Both exact specializations must compile with actual initial96 registers, zero local storage and positive occupancy at640threads and231168 dynamic shared bytes. Fail closed; no alternate quota or fallback.
Retain the one-block launch bound and WGS-only verbose diagnostics. Source quota dominance does not establish honored instructions or asynchronous pipeline scheduling.

Observed persistent C7511/C7512 or equivalent WGMMA serialization, dropped setmaxnreg hints, or visible spill growth kills the selected mechanism. Retained SASS USETMAXREG/quotas are stronger mechanism evidence if externally available; do not spawn artifact inspection from submission code.
The96-register birth-budget compiler limitation remains. Existing MMA instructions compile at96, but that does not prove additional live AF/deferred-flush state can use112 or avoid serialization.
Noinline wgs_ranges under producer32 and FCI3 under consumer112 remain actual compilation risks. Do not fold producer rewrites or helper changes into this experiment to rescue it.
A truncated or absent diagnostic is not proof of warning absence. Preserve actual log scope and qualify mechanism claims if binary evidence is unavailable.

performance_gate.target: Geometric mean of incumbent_speedup/candidate_speedup <=0.95 across affected cases; no affected case ratio>1.03; stable unchanged controls.
performance_gate.caveat: These are screening thresholds, not gain forecasts or a proof of causality. Useful standalone evidence still requires separate exact decoder integration and verification.
